comment: Known Claude seats, shared by the UI (src/lib/claudeUsage.ts) and the capacity exporter (src-tauri/src/commands/claude_usage.rs). The fleet seat registry stays the source of truth for which seats exist and for the account name claude-usage reports each seat under (its usage_account, the primary join label). usage_labels here are only a fallback for a seat the registry does not list or has no usage_account for; launcher is the command that starts Claude on that seat. Retired aliases (claude-gustavo) and the default ~/.claude login (mac-max) are deliberately not listed: neither is a seat.
